Sam (sales): Priya from VertexAI Labs just submitted their supplier security questionnaire (SIG-lite + custom appendix). They want a response by EOD Wed. Link: https://s3.company/vertexai/sig_2026.pdf :eyes:
Leah (solutions): Thanks — can someone own the Q intake? Looks like a few network and key-management questions we need to surface to infra/security.
Rhea (security): I can take this. Quick triage: is this a POC ask or a contract-signing gate?
Sam (sales): It's for a POC first, then managed dedicated if all good. They called out SOC2, KMS/HSM, and data residency in EU. Also asked about on-prem option.
Mike (security): FYI, SOC2 evidence requests usually need 48-72h to gather from compliance team. KMS/HSM details we can provide, but on-prem packaging requires legal + infra lead time.
Anna (legal): We'll need them to sign the mutual NDA before sharing SOC2 artifacts. Sam — do we have an NDA on file?
Sam (sales): Not yet. Priya said they can sign ours today. I've pinged them in thread.
Customer - Priya: Happy to sign. Quick Q: For the POC, can we get a short-lived dedicated instance in eu-west-1 with 1 GPU? We need to validate latency with our sample prompts.
Leah (solutions): POC request noted. We usually do ephemeral Dedicated for POCs under a POC agreement — ops approval required.
Rhea (security): For POC infra access we require:
- minimal privilege service account + IP allowlist
- data classification statement (no PHI)
- retention policy for logs
If they agree, we can approve a sandbox instance with host-level monitoring.
Sam (sales): I can get them to confirm the data types. Priya — can you confirm no PHI and provide a contact for security ops?
Customer - Priya: Confirmed: no PHI. Contact: priya.s@vertex.ai. Also ok with IP allowlist.
Rhea (security): OK. I'll start the questionnaire answers. Open items I need from Sales/Solutions:
1) Network diagram for POC (Leah)
2) Model persistence / KV cache config we serve (Leah / infra)
3) KMS/HSM vendor and key rotation policy (Mike/infra)
4) Any pre-signed SOC2 artifacts we can share (Anna/compliance)
Sam (sales): ETA on answers? Customer needs by Wednesday EOD.
Rhea (security): I can get a draft back in ~48h for internal review if we get items 1-3 today. SOC2 artifacts depend on legal/compliance timeline.
Leah (solutions): I'll drop the network diagram in this thread by EOD.
Mike (security): I'll pull the KMS notes and rotation policy; might take until tomorrow morning.
Anna (legal): I'll queue the SOC2 share request to compliance; will update by noon tomorrow. NDA first though — Sam pls confirm once signed.
Sam (sales): NDA sent to Priya (DocuSign). Noted.
Rhea (security): Great. Once I have items I'll populate SIG answers and mark any customer-facing redlines. Small ask: Leah, can you provide a short canned blurb about our ephemeral POC topology I can paste into the questionnaire? Something like: `Redwood provides ephemeral dedicated instances isolated per-customer with host-level telemetry and configurable network allowlists.`
Leah (solutions): Sure — pasteable blurb: `Redwood provisions ephemeral dedicated POCs in the requested cloud region. Instances are isolated per-customer, include host-level monitoring, require IP allowlisting, and integrate with customer-managed KMS where applicable.`
Rhea (security): Perfect, thanks.
Customer - Priya: Appreciate the fast turn. If you need any form signatures from our side beyond NDA let me know.
Sam (sales): Noted. Will confirm once DOCUSIGN completes. Team — I'll follow up if any escalations from the AE. :thumbsup:
